Install the moose widget

Overview

This guide explains how to install the moose widget and confirm that it runs. Follow it when you are setting up a new workspace, or after upgrading to a major release.

Before you start

Make sure you have the following:

  • Node.js 24 or later, on your PATH.
  • Write access to the workspace you are installing into.
  • A registry token, if you install from a private registry.

Install the widget

Install the widget into the workspace you want it in.

  1. Open a terminal in the workspace root.

  2. Install the package:

    npm install moose-widget

  3. Add the widget to your configuration:

    widgets:
  - moose

Verify the installation

Print the installed version. Any version number means it worked.

npx moose-widget --version

The first run downloads the widget's assets, so it takes longer than later runs.
